claims.description: The adult family-intent profile creation path records only the pending learner-target UI state; it no longer writes family context or redirects to child-profile creation, and a failed durable write retries without duplicating the profile POST.
The plain-language Me and Someone else branches, own-login question, credentialed invitation route, and explicit managed-path gate are covered as one non-authorizing UI state machine.

Profile-scoped pending state survives an in-memory reset that represents remount or relaunch, restores every unfinished step, rejects authorizing-shaped data, and never exposes a write or clear that SecureStore rejected.
A storage read begun before sign-out cannot repopulate discarded state, and recovery-only state repairs the missing SecureStore primary after a successful restore.

The signed-in app layout restores the pending fork for the matching active profile, fails closed with retry on rejected or timed-out reads, and preserves existing preview/profile and navigation-shell gate behavior.

The existing-account target opens the family-join invitation form directly under the live V2 launch flag and consumes the durable marker only after that route mounts; older flag configurations retain the explicit unavailable state without consuming the marker.

During the restore-probe and retry window, the blocked learner shell remains React-mounted to preserve navigator state but is display-hidden, pointer-inert, and excluded from native accessibility; restoring a pending fork then early-returns to its gate and unmounts Tabs.
The preview journey starts with no Person or supportership edge, creates the adult, chooses Someone else, answers the login question, and reaches the invitation form without a visibility-link write.
